coverage.member: FusionBreadcrumb(#if NET48 this HtmlHelper<TModel> html, #else this IHtmlHelper<TModel> html, #endif ReactivePlan<TModel> plan, string elementId, Action<BreadcrumbBuilder> build)
coverage.catches: the FusionBreadcrumb render helper stops rendering the trail bound to the model items (the test asserts the Sunrise Court and Eleanor Hughes crumbs are visible and the Care Plan crumb is current at first paint)

the ActiveItem() source stops reading the active crumb url, so the DomReady Eq(carePlanUrl) branch no longer matches and the viewing-now caption shows the Else text instead of the Care Plan message the test asserts
the ItemClick event selector stops firing the reactive handler when a crumb is clicked, so clicking Eleanor Hughes never opens the section panel or sets its heading
the .Reactive wiring stops connecting the breadcrumb's itemClick event to its plan pipeline, so clicking a crumb runs no reaction and the section panel stays hidden
the item-click args contract stops delivering the click payload into the plan, so the opened-section heading is never set and the panel does not appear
the Item payload property stops carrying the clicked crumb, so x.Item.Text resolves to nothing and the opened-section heading the test asserts (Eleanor Hughes) never appears

the FusionBreadcrumbItem payload contract stops shaping the clicked crumb (text/id/url/iconCss/disabled), so x.Item.Url no longer resolves and the server-resolved community summary the test asserts never shows
Item.Text stops carrying the clicked crumb's text, so the opened-section heading no longer reads 'Eleanor Hughes' as the test asserts
Item.IconCss stops carrying the clicked crumb's icon classes, so the opened-section icon tag no longer reads 'e-icons e-user' for the resident crumb the test clicks
Item.Url stops carrying the clicked crumb's url into the gather body, so the server resolves no summary for the community url and the test's asserted summary text never shows
Item.Id stops carrying the clicked crumb's id into the gather body, so the server resolves no code for id 'resident' and the section code badge no longer reads 'RES-214' as the test asserts

Item.Disabled stops carrying the clicked crumb's disabled flag into the gather body, so the POST no longer contains "disabled":false under its declared key (the test asserts the exact substring in request.PostData)

coverage.member: SetActiveItem(this ComponentRef<FusionBreadcrumb, TModel> self, string activeItem)
coverage.catches: SetActiveItem stops writing the resident url and chaining dataBind(), so clicking 'Back to the resident's overview' leaves Care Plan as the current crumb instead of moving aria-current to Eleanor Hughes as the test asserts

acceptedFanout.reason: one user gesture (clicking the Eleanor Hughes crumb) proves the click-delivery chain whose members cannot be isolated by separate gestures: ItemClick must fire, .Reactive must connect it, FusionBreadcrumbItemClickArgs must deliver the payload, .Item must carry the clicked crumb, and .Item.Text must read its text — if ANY of these breaks, the opened-section heading never reads 'Eleanor Hughes' and the panel never opens, so the test's two assertions (heading text + panel visible) fail. The remaining per-property members (IconCss, Url, Id, Disabled) each have their OWN test with a distinct fails-when-broken assertion; this fan-out covers only the indivisible delivery chain plus the one property (Text) that names the heading.
